items.title: Eddie Miller and Pete Fountain Interview, 1970-01-09
items.q: Stanley Dance calls Eddie the first of the cool tenors.

ctx.x: Oh, I think they will. I hope so. This came out real good with him. I guess when they find the right songs, as they say, they always tell you that. But we know them all. And we could, you know, like, they could do all the pretty songs of Eddie, you know, done through the years. And I think it'd be a fantastic album. You know, like Music for Lovers, because he can do it.
Stanley Dance calls Eddie the first of the cool tenors. Really?
Yeah. Well, that's quite a compliment from him.
